t: This is 67 Pont Street, in the SW1X area on the Kensington and Chelsea side. It was designed by C. W. Stephens. Stephens was architect to Harrods from 1892 until his death, and he was responsible for the store's famous Baroque-style façade on Brompton Road. His other work includes Harvey Nichols, the new Claridge's hotel and the Park Lane Hotel, so this house belongs to a body of work you can see across the West End and Knightsbridge.
